## Symptom
The nightly digest job fails at its first query and succeeds when it is run later in the morning (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6790233104, run:fixture-org/inkwell/6790561877).

## Root cause
The store was still resuming when the job connected. The 30 s connect timeout was not enough for the compute to come up, so the first connection failed again (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6790233104). The manual run in the morning succeeded because the store was awake by then (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6790561877).

## Fix / workaround
Raise the connect timeout to 120 s and connect three times (issue:fixture-org/inkwell#27).

## How it is caught
It is not. The job succeeds when it is run again (raw:20261012T084612Z-d0431f6a).
